title: Full-Court Four-Corners Relay
description: Teams race in a relay that requires dribbling to all four corners of the full court before finishing with a layup, combining speed and ball control.

content.objective: Combine speed, ball control and finishing under the pressure of a timed team relay.
content.setup: Teams line up at one baseline; the course requires touching all four corners of the full court.
instructions: The first player dribbles to touch each of the four corners of the court in sequence.
After touching all four corners, finish with a layup at the starting basket.
Tag the next teammate to begin their turn immediately after the layup.
The team that finishes all players first wins the relay.
coachingPoints: Keep the dribble under control even while racing the clock.
Take the most efficient path between corners without cutting the course short.
Finish the layup properly rather than rushing and missing, which costs more time overall.
commonMistakes: Cutting corners short instead of actually touching each one.
Losing the dribble by moving faster than the handle allows.
Rushing decisions just because the format feels competitive.
content.safety: Make sure the full-court course is clear of other equipment and groups.
